$comment: Operator precedent library (scripts/lib/review-precedents.mjs). review.precedents.inject on|off: review jurors are shown the ACTIVE precedents that match the PR's touched paths, lens and keywords, as fenced untrusted data (env WE_REVIEW_PRECEDENTS_INJECT). review.precedents.maxCount (1..20) and review.precedents.maxChars (500..20000) cap how many precedents and how much text one juror request carries (env WE_REVIEW_PRECEDENTS_MAX_COUNT / WE_REVIEW_PRECEDENTS_MAX_CHARS). review.precedents.autoDecide off|on: reserved for letting a well-agreed precedent decide without a human; it stays off, and even when on it never applies to a PR touching a human-only surface (scripts/settings/human-review-surfaces.json); env WE_REVIEW_PRECEDENTS_AUTO_DECIDE. Cascade: built-in default, then this file, then env; an invalid value keeps the lower layer. The effective value and its source layer are logged once per process.
